unit.description: One function or a small group, in-process, nothing external.

component.description: A coherent UI component rendered in-process, outer boundaries faked.

architecture-static.description: A codebase, build or dependency rule enforced by reading source or running the compiler. No database.

architecture-db.description: A rule about the live schema, grants or roles, asked of the real local Postgres.

database-integration.description: Domain layer and/or policies against real local Supabase (Auth, Postgres, RLS).

offline-contract.description: A provider or protocol shape checked offline from the web runtime: what an adapter sends a vendor and how it reads the reply, with fetch replaced.

python-unit.description: Python: one function or a small group.

python-component.description: Python: a command or handler with its outer HTTP/database boundary faked.

python-contract.description: Python: a provider or protocol shape, checked offline.

playwright-acceptance.description: Browser journeys against the running app and seeded demo data.

playwright-smoke.description: The smallest deployed-shaped check: app answers, login renders, a session works, the shell loads.

playwright-visual.description: Pixel baselines at desktop/tablet/phone widths for a small set of representative patterns — spacing, alignment and responsive composition, never a business rule. Never in the default run: a baseline drifts with design intent, not with correctness, and a diff here is a prompt to look, not a build failure.

provider-contract.description: A real vendor sandbox, called with credentials. Never in the default run; each test skips itself without its credentials. None exist yet.

apps/web/e2e/dialer-popout.spec.ts.note: Real browser popup, draft, workspace navigation, mobile geometry and browser-chrome closure; never places a call.

apps/web/tests/component/dialer-popout.t.note: Compact dialer window shares telephone state, preserves drafts, and restores controls without ending calls.

apps/api/tests/component/test_ai_runtime.note: No-assignment falls back to the legacy default; an explicit assignment never fails over.

apps/api/tests/component/test_dns_operat.note: ensure_required_records: which connected zone answers, unchanged/created/updated/conflict. The vendor boundary (app.services.dns.cloudflare) is replaced, the same shape test_web_delivery_domains.py holds for app.providers.vercel.domains.

apps/api/tests/component/test_domains_cr.note: Domain command over a patched PostgREST call.

apps/api/tests/component/test_tenant_ema.note: A business's own email: the send sequencing (claim, record, retry), the Resend protocol reading, tenant event parsing and inbound persistence, with the provider and database doors replaced.

apps/api/tests/component/test_sms_status.note: The carrier's delivery vocabulary is translated at the provider boundary; an unknown word is acknowledged, an unsigned callback writes nothing.

apps/api/tests/component/test_domains_ro.note: The routing resolver's own branching over a faked transport — business hours, ring strategies, fallback, cycle rejection, callback affinity, outbound AUTO/MANUAL.

apps/api/tests/component/test_domains_vo.note: Domain command over a patched PostgREST call.

apps/api/tests/component/test_email_prov.note: Authorization before the credential is read, every provider outcome recorded before it is returned, DNS written only when asked, and publishing DNS never recorded as verification.

apps/api/tests/component/test_google_ans.note: Translation against a mocked SDK boundary; Part/Content construction runs against the real installed SDK.

apps/api/tests/component/test_handlers.p.note: Drives every apps/api/api entrypoint in-process: the refusal, and that the sink was never reached.

apps/api/tests/component/test_integratio.note: Component, despite the filename: every boundary is patched. "Integration" names the product feature.

apps/api/tests/component/test_openai_ans.note: Translation against a mocked SDK boundary, mirroring the Anthropic/dialect adapters' shape.

apps/api/tests/component/test_platform_e.note: send_invitation_email: the recipient always comes from the invitation row, the account is tried before the environment, every outcome is recorded. The vendor boundary (send_platform_email) is replaced.

apps/api/tests/component/test_web_delive.note: Replaces app.providers.vercel.domains and the db.py machine-role callers; the database half is organization-domains.test.ts.

apps/api/tests/contract/test_resend_acco.note: GOLD's own Resend account: whether the stored credential works, offline.

apps/api/tests/contract/test_resend_doma.note: What GildOps sends the email provider's Domains API and how it reads the answers, including the three ways a retry arrives. Mocked HTTP; nothing leaves the process.

apps/api/tests/contract/test_resend_plat.note: send_platform_email: the platform-email-specific Resend call that returns a provider message id, offline.

apps/api/tests/contract/test_resend_webh.note: Resend's Svix-shaped signature (every header, a tampered body, a stale timestamp, a wrong secret) and the event-to-state mapping, offline.

apps/api/tests/contract/test_vercel_doma.note: Vercel's Domains API, offline: register/config/verify/remove and normalize().

apps/web/tests/architecture/database/usa.note: communication_rates stays gone; only app.record_usage writes usage_events.

apps/web/tests/architecture/database/voi.note: Phase F: a call carries no carrier identifier, the carrier and a tenant write it only through narrow doors, status only moves forward, readiness is derived.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/miles.note: Named for a roadmap period; it is a source scan.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/commu.note: Conversation is channel-capable, a sender address is never a client value, and calling and messaging stay two navigation authorities.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/inbox.note: One canonical Inbox query and screen, one membership-keyed assignment mechanism, and Communications linking to CRM without becoming it.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/sms-b.note: SMS is a channel of canonical Communications, the carrier stays behind the adapter, and the carrier alone decides a text's state.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/organ.note: Holds the "every page calls requireOrganization" rule.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/platf.note: Reads source and the seeding migration; renders nothing.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/publi.note: Also runs canonical-URL, sitemap and robots functions.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/pytho.note: Files in apps/api/api, vercel.json, the README route table and test_handlers.py must agree.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/role-.note: Slice 0A. Role presets are templates only; nothing branches on a role/preset name.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/sched.note: Slice 0A. Guards against faking self/team schedule visibility via name, role, created_by or a custom field.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/setti.note: The one database-backed authority test moved to settings-configuration-authority.test.ts.
Also runs the pure Settings-map gating functions.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/voice.note: Phase F: the call domain speaks only the capability, screens never reach the carrier, one call list, numbers are configured and never provisioned.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/tailw.note: Runs the real PostCSS and Tailwind compile.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/team-.note: Also runs a pure view resolver.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/test-.note: Guards this manifest: every test file classified, no stale entries.

apps/web/tests/component/active-call-doc.note: Phase F: the live call bar over a fake telephone; leave vs end, hold, add and transfer tell the truth about what the server said.

apps/web/tests/component/required-record.note: The provider's required DNS records render whole (a long DKIM key is never truncated), with MX priority and per-record verification status.

apps/web/tests/contract/platform-email.t.note: The relay to apps/api's /invitation_email: what is sent (never a subject or body, only an id and a link), and the unconfigured-deployment null. Names no vendor — apps/api's own suite covers the Resend call.

apps/web/tests/contract/twilio-browser-t.note: The browser softphone token boundary (browserTelephoneToken) had no test.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/agen.note: Fakes fetch for the assistant URL only.
Fakes fetch for the assistant URL only; also reads the migration for its backfill.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/ai-r.note: The table has no select grant to any role, staff included; overview/record/resolve are the only three doors.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/bran.note: Also runs pure palette maths and reads globals.css.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/call.note: Phase F: a call is one fact settled from its legs, inbound recording, live controls and transfers against a fake carrier, and number configuration.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/cata.note: Which platform tables each kind of caller may read.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/comm.note: Named for the credit purse and call cost, not messaging.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/inte.note: Also scans apps/web for credential names.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/invi.note: Reissue rotates the token and the expiry; invitation_deliveries tenant isolation; provider_operator/invitation_email_webhook hold no table grant and exactly the narrow doors; the webhook's own correlation by provider message id and its payload-hash dedupe.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/laun.note: Cross-tenant and external DENY cases for organization_launch_blockers.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/comm.note: Channel-typed conversations and tenant-scoped email identities against real RLS.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/mess.note: The server resolves the SMS sender from a number id; the carrier is replaced by a recorder, everything else is real.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/emai.note: Email as a channel of messages: queueing, the provider doors, delivery events, inbound threading and attachments, against real RLS and Storage.
The SendEmail and ReplyToConversation commands with the tenant email capability replaced by a recorder.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/inbo.note: The Inbox over SMS and email, conversation status, assignment, and customer resolution against real RLS.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/sms-.note: A text's whole life against real RLS with the carrier replaced: who may write its state, forward-only callbacks, usage once, suppression, inbound idempotency and tenant isolation.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/mile.note: Stubs the drafting adapter. Also contains source scans.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/orga.note: One describe stubs nothing; the provider_operator writes go through raw SQL under `set local role`, like provider-accounts.test.ts.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/plat.note: Stripe HTTP is stubbed with fetch spies; not a provider contract.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/prov.note: Mocks the API client and telephony adapter. Also scans apps/web for secret names.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/reso.note: Slice 0B. Resource<->Membership FK/index behaviour, resource.update authority, current-member resolution, and that Schedule visibility stays organization-wide.
DENY cases for the two definer booking views: another member, an unbound visitor, no session, filter widening.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/serv.note: Webhook function called directly; no Stripe traffic. next/navigation and getDb are replaced so the route guard can be driven.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/sess.note: Also runs pure classification and redirect rules.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/usag.note: Retail-rate resolution, usage provenance and tenant integrity, historical cost, the recording door.

apps/web/tests/unit/email-identity-readi.note: Email identity readiness is derived from what backs the address; the tenant email provider seam has no implementation yet.

apps/web/tests/unit/email-content.test.t.note: Received HTML is sanitized against the classic vectors; what an email may carry.

apps/web/tests/unit/sending-domain-prese.note: The eight presentation states a sending domain reads as, and the sentence/badge for each; never confuses a refused account with a refused name.

apps/web/tests/unit/forms-definition.tes.note: The form definition vocabulary, answer checking and the builder's edits that keep a field's identity.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/form.note: Form lifecycle, exact-revision submissions, anonymous door, tenant isolation and template independence against real Postgres.

apps/web/tests/component/form-builder.te.note: The Studio form builder's add, select, edit, remove, reorder, dirty and publish behaviour, and the shared renderer's label/error association.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/porta.note: The portal link is exchanged once in a route handler into an HttpOnly session of its own; every portal operation takes identity from that session, never from the browser.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/forms.note: Forms are not booking, one renderer, slug-addressed anonymous doors, no infrastructure in authoring.

apps/web/e2e/portal-booking-forms.spec.t.note: Portal link exchanged once into its own session, portal form, revocation, booking with the business's own questions, refusals that book nothing, Studio/portal/public coexistence, phone width.

apps/web/e2e/studio-drawer-layout.spec.t.note: Shared drawer gutters, fixed chrome, focus return and isolated template previews at desktop, tablet and phone widths.

apps/web/e2e/studio-forms.spec.ts.note: Blank and template journeys from Studio to a published form to a submitted response, and draft isolation.

apps/web/tests/unit/anonymous-session.te.note: A public write ends only the session it began: the helper, and the marketing intake that shares it.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/book.note: A booking asks its business's own form: configuration refusals, revision pinning, booking and response in one transaction (a refusal leaves neither), the link in both directions, identifiers-only event, no flood guard.

apps/web/tests/integration/database/form.note: Website form section, hostname and key reads, portal identity derived from the link, response-to-customer linking, archive safety and the signed-in session regression.

apps/web/tests/component/form-placements.note: The website form section's modes, the public form's focus on a refused submit, and the portal list.

apps/web/e2e/studio-form-distribution.sp.note: A form on the website, a business hostname, the portal, another site's embed and the stable link; the signed-in session regression; keyboard and phone width.

apps/api/tests/component/test_connector_.note: The API's own answer to whether a connector can be connected here: the one authority the web asks, and what each caller may learn from it.

apps/api/tests/component/test_secret_res.note: The one machine door that reads a business's stored value: the role it wears, what it sends, and that a failure carries no value.

apps/api/tests/contract/test_github_conn.note: GitHub's own installation handshake, offline: the installation id is proven to be the signing-in user's before a token is minted. Proves the contract GildOps depends on, not that a GitHub App is registered.

apps/api/tests/unit/test_credential_boun.note: Static scan: a connector holds no door onto Vault, and each credential has one reader.

apps/web/tests/architecture/static/provi.note: Holds the web's list of account-capable providers to the API's registry, both ways.

apps/web/e2e/studio-website.spec.ts.note: A business creates its own website, composes pages and sections, previews privately, publishes, restores, and a stranger reads it at its hostname.

apps/web/tests/unit/website-composition..note: Page and section composition, the closed vocabulary, reserved paths and stable ids.

apps/web/tests/component/website-workben.note: The Website workbench: creation, pages, sections, reordering, unsaved state and read-only review.
